service.description: The caller's People scope: capabilities from the People and payroll permissions (an edit permission alone reads nothing), the employers a staff reader sees (their own internal organizations, only the active one when it is theirs; every one, or the active one, for a holder of PEOPLE_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS, which reads nothing by itself) and the units under them, their own party and current employments, and a manager's live reports. With organizationPartyId, narrows the employers, the units and a staff admission to it and refuses one outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED). With partyId, says how the scope admits that person (self, team or staff) and which of their employments it shows (staff: an employment by an employer in scope, in effect on asOfDate for a directory reader, any for an HR reader), and refuses a person it does not admit as it refuses a missing one (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); a supplied party never widens self scope.

parameter.name: asOfDate
parameter.description: The date a directory reader's employments are in effect on; now when empty

parameter.name: checkOnly
parameter.description: For a caller asking whether the person is admitted (a link shown only then): a person missing or outside the scope answers partyAccess empty instead of RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, alike either way

parameter.name: employments
parameter.description: The caller's own current employments: partyRelationshipId, partyId, organizationPartyId, fromDate, thruDate

parameter.name: partyAccess
parameter.description: self, team and staff, as each admits the party asked for

service.description: People Home's summary for a staff reader, over the employers in scope or the one asked for (refused outside the scope, ORGANIZATION_DENIED), as of asOfDate (now when empty): headcount (distinct people) and employments for a staff reader, the joins and exits of the last 30 days for an HR reader, each count of a later phase absent; and the due work an HR reader clears (employees with no manager, by name, the first 20 of dueWorkCount). Pay is never counted. Refuses a caller who reads no employer (PERMISSION_DENIED).

parameter.name: counts
parameter.description: headcount, employments, joins and exits, each present only for a caller who may read it

parameter.name: dueWork
parameter.description: dueKind, dueText, partyId, personName, organizationPartyId, organizationName

service.description: People's setup readiness, answering Admin's readiness contract with no adapter: called with providerKey and an organizationPartyId (or none, for every employer in the caller's scope), returns checks of checkKey, title, state (ready, warning, failed or unavailable), reasonCode, message and fixPath, with the organization's id and name. The checks of what is built, for an organization with current employees (one with none answers no check): a department set up, every employee with a manager. Later phases add theirs. Refuses a caller without PEOPLE_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an organization outside their scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

The employee directory (design §4 Employees, §15): one row per employment the caller's scope reaches as of asOfDate (now when empty; a date alone is the end of that day): an employment by an employer a staff reader sees, a live report's and, with PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE, the caller's own. Each row is the public work identity (name, preferred name, employer, job title, manager employed by that employer, work email (EmailWork, never EmailPrimary), phone and location, the state); an HR reader (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW) gets the id and dates of an employment by an employer in their scope too, and with includeEnded the ended employments. Never a private contact, identification or pay. Searched by term (name, preferred name or id) in the query ignoring case; filtered by employer (refused outside the scope, ORGANIZATION_DENIED) and manager; paged, or with pageNoLimit (an export) every row up to 2000. Refuses a caller the scope reaches no one for (PERMISSION_DENIED).

parameter.name: employees

service.description: A person's record as the caller may read it (design §4 Employee360): the regions their access admits, each one they may not read absent from the answer. Overview (any reader the scope admits): the public work identity and the employments the scope shows of the person (an HR reader's with their dates). EmploymentHistory and PersonalInfo (the person, and an HR reader of an employer of theirs): personalInfo holds the private contacts, birth date, gender and the revision store#PersonalInfo checks, and for HR the identifications other than tax ones, values masked. FilesAndActivity (an HR reader of the employer of the employment opened): hostEmploymentId, the employment content host. partyRelationshipId opens an employment the scope shows (else RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); without it, the current one, then the newest. A person outside the scope is refused as a missing one (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). Never pay, review, case or leave data. A manager shown is one of a shown employment's employer (or employed by none); HR's dates and employment ids are of the employments by an employer in their scope.

parameter.name: checkOnly
parameter.description: For a caller that shows the record only when it is readable (a card, a link): a person or employment missing or outside the scope answers access and regions empty instead of RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, alike either way

parameter.name: access
parameter.description: self, team and staff, as get#Scope admits the person

parameter.name: regions
parameter.description: overview, and employmentHistory, personalInfo and filesAndActivity as admitted

parameter.name: partyRelationshipId
parameter.description: The employment opened, for the person and HR; null for a directory or team reader

parameter.name: capabilities
parameter.description: editPersonal, editHr, selfFields (the fields the caller may change), files

service.description: A person's employments, newest first, with employer, job title, dates, state and termination reason (design §4 EmploymentHistory; P6 adds the dated assignments): an HR reader's of the employers in their scope, any dates; the person's own, all of them. Refuses anyone else (PERMISSION_DENIED) and a person outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Correct a person's private data (design §4 PersonalInfo). The person themselves (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE) may change their preferred name and home and mobile phones; an HR editor (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT) of an employer of theirs these and the legal names, birth date, gender and home address. A field left out is unchanged, an empty one is cleared (a legal name cannot be, NAME_REQUIRED). Tax and bank fields are not taken here: they are reviewed payroll setup. Refuses a person outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a caller who may change nothing of the person (PERMISSION_DENIED), a field the caller may not change (FIELD_NOT_PERMITTED) and an expectedRevision other than the current one (REVISION_CHANGED, naming it). Contacts change by date: the one in effect ends and a new one starts.

Whether the caller reads an employment's files and activity, the employment content host (PE-01): an HR reader (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW) of its employer in their scope; canEdit with PEOPLE_HR_EDIT. Never refuses: a relationship that is not an employment, or not the caller's to read, answers recordVisible false, and so does a call with no user. get#RecordLinkInfo and RecordFiles read it.

A file of an employment (EmploymentContent, the record files of get#RecordLinkInfo): the row, and the uploaded file saved through save#EmploymentContentFile. Needs an HR editor of the employer (check#EmploymentAccess: RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside the scope, PERMISSION_DENIED without PEOPLE_HR_EDIT).
Internal to create#EmploymentContent, which checks the caller: the file of an EmploymentContent row of that employment.

return.message: RECORD_UNAVAILABLE: File ${employmentContentId} is not of employment ${partyRelationshipId}
